name: 4 - Generate Report

on:
  schedule:
    # Se ejecuta a las 15:30 UTC (30 min después del Script 3)
    - cron: '30 15 * * 1'
  
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  generate-report:
    name: Generate Quarto Report
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    
    permissions:
      contents: write
    
    steps:
    - name: 📚 Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
    
    - name: 🐍 Setup Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: "3.12"
        cache: 'pip'
    
    - name: 📦 Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install -r requirements.txt
    
    - name: 📊 Install Quarto
      uses: quarto-dev/quarto-actions/setup@v2
      with:
        version: '1.5.57' # Usa una versión estable reciente
    
    - name: 🚀 Generate Reports
      run: |
        python -m scripts.4_report_generator --lang both --format html
      env:
        DEEPSEEK_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY }}
        GITHUB_ACTIONS: true
    
    - name: 📤 Commit and push reports
      run: |
        git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
        git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
        
        # Solo agregamos los HTML generados
        git add reports/*.html
        
        if git diff --cached --quiet; then
          echo "🔭 No changes to commit"
        else
          DATE=$(date +'%Y-%m-%d')
          git commit -m "📊 Generated weekly report ${DATE} [Automated]"
          
          git pull --rebase origin main
          git push origin HEAD:main
          echo "✅ Reports pushed successfully"
        fi
